column2: AN ACT TO AMEND THE TRUSTS ORDINANCE (CHAPTER 87)
BE it enacted by the Parliament of the Democratic Socialist
Republic of Sri Lanka as follows:—

1.
This  Act  may  be  cited  as  the  Trusts  (Amendment)
Act, No.    of 2017.

2.
Section  3  of  the  Trusts  Ordinance  (Chapter  87)
(hereinafter referred to as the “principal enactment”) is hereby
amended by the repeal of  paragraph (e) of that section and
the substitution therefor of the following paragraphs:-

“(e)
“beneficiary”  means  a  person,  or  a  defined  or
definitely ascertainable class of persons, for whose
benefit the confidence is accepted;

(ee)
“prescribed” means prescribed by regulations made
under this Act;” .
